entities.name: Ur-Ninurta
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ur-Ninurta was the 6th king of the 1st Dynasty of Isin. A usurper, Ur-Ninurta seized the throne on the fall of Lipit-Ishtar and held it until his violent death some 28 years later.
